description: This Kotlin source file defines the DiscoverPresenter composable function and related data models for managing and displaying app discovery content in an Android app, including handling different loading states and data sources.

classes.name: DiscoverModel
classes.description: Sealed class representing different states of the discover UI, including loading, first start, no enabled repos, and loaded states.

classes.name: FirstStartDiscoverModel
classes.description: Data class representing the state when the app is starting for the first time, including network and repository update states.

classes.name: LoadingDiscoverModel
classes.description: Object representing the loading state of the discover UI.

classes.name: NoEnabledReposDiscoverModel
classes.description: Object indicating that no repositories are enabled.

classes.name: LoadedDiscoverModel
classes.description: Data class representing the fully loaded state with app lists, categories, and UI states.

methods.name: DiscoverPresenter
methods.description: Composable function that manages the discovery screen state based on various app, category, and repository data flows.
